profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Results-driven Senior Full Stack Engineer with a proven track record of designing, developing, and deploying scalable web applications. Proficient in front-end and back-end technologies, with a deep understanding of software architecture and system integration. Experienced in leading cross-functional teams and delivering high-quality solutions in agile environments.

Experience working both remotely as well as in an office environment.

TECH SKILLS
=========
JavaScript, Typescript, React, NextJS, HTML5, CSS3, ES6, NodeJS, Express, MongoDB, Redux, Git, Webpack, Chrome APIs, CI/CD Pipelines

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Architected and developed a comprehensive content management system
(CMS) specifically tailored for real estate agents, using company branding

Demonstrated adaptability by swiftly transitioning focus to the Acre's
geospatial tool, with a goal of enhancing user experience, accessibility,
and driving overall platform revenue

Spearheaded the adoption of Trunk Based Development methodologies,
revolutionizing the development process and driving a 50% reduction in
cycle time

Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams to understand user
needs, business objectives, and technical requirements

Actively participated in regular team meetings, contributing ideas for
product enhancements and collaborating on future development plans
